coreset.sampling_method: quota stratified by target distribution plus high-variance feature quantile bins

notes.fidelity_privacy: DCR share and DOMIAS AUC are empirical. A larger value sits nearer the fit view. Not a utility win, not DP, and not HIPAA.
notes.friedman: Nemenyi CD uses Demsar q_alpha 2.569 for four methods at alpha 0.05
notes.holm_family_density: 9 tests, 3 comparators times 3 auditors, size 4, density block only
notes.holm_family_fidelity_density: 12 tests, 4 metrics times 3 density comparators, grouped validation, not pooled with retention
notes.holm_family_fidelity_neural: 8 tests, 4 metrics times CTGAN and TVAE on the neural lineages only, not pooled
notes.holm_family_forest: Forest-Flow native_selected, size 4, six-lineage confirmation, not pooled
notes.holm_family_neural: CTGAN and TVAE times auditors, size 4, not pooled with density
notes.interval: percentile lineage bootstrap of the median; three sample seeds stay inside each lineage median
notes.strongest_baseline: highest paired median retention inside the block and auditor; blocks are not pooled
notes.superiority: Retention tests do not authorize PTF-v1, MFS-v2, or release-safe L3
notes.wins: lineage counts of positive, zero, and negative paired differences, DOPE minus the baseline

beyond.source: beyondarena-prepared-v1/fits receipt.json, report.json, and the final loss.tsv row
beyond.validation_column: third TSV field, the hidden-basis validation loss

forest_cost.limitations: Prior immutable metrics add no new compute. Operation time includes hashing, generation and native auditors; device power includes idle and is not job-attributed. Earlier DOPE architecture research is a separate cost; per-cell budgets do not imply equal total research spend.

loss.stride_note: band evaluated every 8 steps and linearly filled

provenance_counts.note: File-name counts only. Test file contents were not read.
